McpServerDefinition.description: Governed Apex over the LOS loan book: list loans, resolve one and its Box documents, ask Box AI, extract and apply loan terms, draft a commitment letter, prepare a signature request. Box credentials stay in Apex, so a client never holds a Box token.

tools.descriptionOverride: Finds documents across every governed loan carrying a given credit policy risk (Critical, High, Medium, Low), with a link to each. Bounded to the loans root by configuration; a caller never supplies a folder id.
tools.toolTitle: Find Loan Documents by Policy Risk

tools.descriptionOverride: Lists LOS loans with loan ID, borrower, status, risk rating and amount, optionally filtered by status or borrower. Use this to answer a portfolio question, then take each loan ID to the loan package.

Finds a LOS loan from the reference a person used, its governed Box folder, and a link to every document in the loan file. Call before asking about, extracting from, or previewing a document: the file ID is the last path segment of each link.
Asks Box AI about one document of a named loan, by a Box file ID from that loan's package. A file outside that loan is refused. With itemType hub it reads the approved credit policy library instead.
tools.toolTitle: Ask Box AI About a Loan Document

tools.descriptionOverride: Extracts amount, rate, term, collateral value, LTV, DSCR and maturity date from one document of a named loan with Box AI, and returns a validation summary naming each mismatch with the record and each policy flag. Writes nothing.
tools.toolTitle: Extract Loan Terms From a Document

tools.descriptionOverride: Writes human-accepted loan terms to the named loan record: only the seven term fields, only the ones supplied, and only with confirmed = true after a person has accepted them. Refuses a Closed or Servicing loan. Never changes status or risk.

Generates the draft commitment letter for a loan into its own Box folder, from the policy at issue, the approved position and exception, and the precedent the caller cites. Loan facts come from the record. The draft is pending Credit Committee approval.

Prepares a Box Sign request for one document of a loan and returns a URL for a human to review and send. It sends nothing. Always call it rather than judging eligibility yourself; the refusal names the blocking status and is the answer.
